_doc: Normalization constants for raw signals before they enter the HRI weighted sum. NOT hardcoded in hri_engine.py. The legacy SEMANTIC_ENERGY_DIVISOR (35.0) is intentionally REMOVED: backend/app/metrics/internal_metrics.semantic_energy now returns a self-normalized flatness value in [0, 1], so no divisor is needed. rcd_scale maps the RCD cosine-distance (typically [0, 0.5]) onto [0, 1] before inversion: rcd_inv = 1 - min(mean_rcd * rcd_scale, 1). prompt_perplexity_divisor maps raw prompt perplexity onto ~[0,1] for the Stage 1 signal.
